params.prompt: Editorial macro photograph of a tilt-shift miniature diorama on a light grey desk, HO-scale model figurines. A large clean printed sheet with the header «КАРТА РИЗИКІВ» and a neat table of rows. Tiny accountants in business clothes place big round coloured stickers beside the rows: one red, two amber, several turquoise #30D5C8. One tiny figure ticks a checkbox with a pencil as big as a log; another presents the sheet with an open hand to a small figure of a business owner. Soft daylight, calm, reassuring, very tidy, white paper, light grey, graphite details.
